CAUSE CALLED, THE COURT ORDERED THAT PLAINTIFF BANK OF THE WEST HAVE AND RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT SIMON, ANTHONY B. INDIVIDUALLY AND DBA TONY'S DIAGNOSTICS POSSESSION OF THE FOLLOWING DESCRIBED PROPERTY, TO WIT: FAIR MARKET VALUE OF EQUIPMENT IS $4000 AND, OR IN CASE A DELIVERY OF SAID PROPERTY TO PLAINTIFF CANNOT BE HAD, THEN THAT THE PLAINTIFF HAVE AND RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT $16,287.14 DAMAGES, $1,975.00 ATTORNEY FEES, $306.41 COSTS, $463.84 INTEREST, TOTAL JUDGMENT $19,032.39, PLAINTIFF IS ENTITLED TO HAVE IMMEDIATELY POSSESSION OF THE EQUIPMENT, SEE JUDGMENT AT LENGTH, SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT
